title: Why are you opening this?
message: Take a breath. Is this a choice or a reflex?

title: Quick check-in
message: You said you wanted to scroll less.

title: What were you about to do?
message: Name the task you came to the phone for.

title: Winding down?
message: Screens late at night push sleep later.

title: You planned to avoid this right now
message: This is one of the apps you chose to guard.

title: Study time is protected
message: Ten more minutes of work beats ten minutes of feed.

title: One more round?
message: Rounds add up faster than they feel.
motivationalMessage: Play on purpose, not on autopilot.

title: Pause before you spend
message: Would you still want this tomorrow?
motivationalMessage: Every skipped impulse is money kept.

title: Move first?
message: A short walk resets attention better than a scroll.
motivationalMessage: Your body is the original focus tool.

title: This app is resting
message: You set this boundary when you were thinking clearly.
motivationalMessage: I want control over my time.

title: Not right now
message: The feed will still be there later.
motivationalMessage: Today's time is already well spent.

title: Time to rest this one
message: Rest is part of the plan.
motivationalMessage: Protect the night, own the morning.

title: Game time is paused
message: You hit the boundary you chose.
motivationalMessage: Stopping on your terms is the real win.

title: Still the plan?
message: You picked a priority this morning. Is this it?

title: Three breaths first
message: In. Out. Now decide.

title: Looking for something specific?
message: Open it with a reason, close it when it's done.
motivationalMessage: Use the app. Don't let it use you.

title: Mid-chapter check
message: One more page, then decide.
motivationalMessage: Momentum is easier to keep than to restart.

title: Quick session or long one?
message: Decide how long before you start.

title: Browsing or buying?
message: Window shopping still nudges you to spend.

title: Been sitting a while?
message: Stand up and stretch before you scroll.

title: Late check-in
message: Is this worth the sleep it costs?
motivationalMessage: Good mornings start the night before.

title: Boredom or need?
message: Boredom passes in a minute if you let it.
motivationalMessage: Sitting with boredom is where ideas come from.

title: You drew this line
message: Past-you set this boundary for a reason.
motivationalMessage: Keep the promise you made yourself.

title: The feed is endless. Your evening isn't.
message: There is no bottom to reach.
motivationalMessage: Spend time where it comes back to you.

title: Deep work in progress
message: Switching now costs more than it feels like.
motivationalMessage: Finish the thought, then reward yourself.

title: Exam-you is watching
message: Every focused hour now is less stress later.

title: It's getting late
message: Blue light and new posts keep your brain awake.

title: Check the clock
message: How long did you plan to play today?
motivationalMessage: Win the day before the match.

title: Cart check
message: Add it to a list and come back in 24 hours.

title: Trade this for ten push-ups?
message: Earn the scroll, or skip it.

title: Focus zone
message: This app is off-limits until your window opens.

title: Books before feeds
message: The block holds until study time ends.

title: Spending is paused
message: You chose to lock this to protect your budget.
motivationalMessage: No purchase beats a goal reached.

title: Go move instead
message: This app reopens later. Your workout can't wait.

title: Boundary reached
message: You hit the limit you set. That's the system working.
motivationalMessage: Control is a muscle. You just used it.

title: Feed's closed for today
message: You already got today's dose.
